composer.$description: The seventh and final piece of the Message/Bubble/Attachment family (see the approved plan). Two variants sharing one shell, the same way Button's 3 variants share one size grid: 'simple' (student side — input + attach icon + Send, matches the live app exactly) and 'rich' (staff side — B/I/U toolbar + Merge Tags + AI Assist + a real Switch for Allow Replies + an expiration row, matches the staff mobile mockups). The text-entry area reuses Input/Select/Search's own locked-in 'fill+border on form fields' convention verbatim (surface.sunken + border.default, strengthening to border.strong on hover, border.focus on focus) rather than inventing a new field recipe, and its value text is size.md (16px) for the same Safari-iOS-auto-zoom reason Input/Select/Search's own value text already is. No expiration date-picker was built — the expiration row is a display/trigger affordance only (label + value + chevron), same scope discipline as not building a full DatePicker component here; wiring a real picker is future work once one exists in this system.

field.$description: Resolves the exact same semantic values Input/Select/Search already use for their own recessed field, not a new recipe.

iconButton.$description: The attach icon (simple) and each B/I/U toolbar button (rich) — resolved from Popover/Drawer/Modal's own close-button recipe (transparent → fill.neutralHover → fill.neutralActive), not re-invented, the same reuse Chip's remove button and Attachment's remove button already established.

aiAssist.$description: The one open call the plan flagged, resolved: formalized fill.ai/bg.ai/text.ai/icon.ai as new semantic roles (tokens/semantic/color.tokens.json) rather than a one-off literal violet — the same bar surface.inverse was added under, since Composer's AI Assist button and the future AI chat product are a genuine cross-product need for one consistent 'this is the AI feature' accent, not a one-off. Rest state is the pale bg.ai tint + text.ai/icon.ai (matches Badge's own tint recipe), border appears on hover using fill.ai — the same 'transparent → role-color border' language Chip's unchecked-hover and Card's own hover already use, not a new hover shade invented for this one button.

mergeTags.$description: A real component.button (ghost, sm size), reused as-is — no new tokens beyond referencing it.

settings.$description: The rich variant's Allow-Replies/Expiration row — Allow Replies is a real component.switch, reused as-is. Expiration is a plain label+value+chevron trigger, not a full date-picker component (deferred, see this component's own top-level $description).

send.$description: A real component.button (primary), reused as-is — icon-only at sm size for the simple variant (matches the live app's compact circular send affordance), icon+label at base size for the rich variant's more prominent 'Reply' action.
